:::{.callout-note}
Please note:

- Workshop attendance is restricted to UK employees of the NHS, public sector, 
civil service, voluntary sector, charities and academia, or who are retirees 
from any of these sectors. 
Please note you must sign up with a work email address to verify your credentials.
- Webinars are free to all to attend, and recordings are stored on our [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@NHSOA_Community).
:::
